method: National live electricity demand is distributed over provinces using CBS population shares and transparent province profile classes. Hour/day factors only change relative provincial shares; all provinces are renormalised every refresh so their sum exactly equals the national live demand.

population_source.title: Huishoudens; personen naar geslacht, leeftijd en regio, 1 januari
population_source.note: Population is used as the baseline spatial weight, not as a measured electricity-consumption share.

assumptions: No public live electricity-demand series per province is used.
Population share is the baseline allocation of national live demand.
Province profile classes are modelling assumptions intended to represent a flatter industrial profile versus a stronger residential/urban morning-evening profile.
Every timestep is normalised back to the measured national live demand, so modelled provincial MW always sums exactly to the national MW value.
Provincial solar and onshore-wind generation are measured NED values; other provincial generation is not included in the provincial renewable balance.
Map routes to TenneT stations are visual aids, not measured physical power flows.
